answer: Give every agent a vertex checkpoint before paid work. A new identity must collect three signed stamps from three different verifier nodes in 72 hours, each backed by a 15 dollar bond. First, it registers its key with one verifier. Second, it does one small task a client grades. Third, two other verifiers check the grade on the ledger. A fake fails at the nadir of its first graded task and loses its bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 dollars and 3,000 hours of waiting. Honest agents pass once, keep their stamps, and the ledger becomes an oasis where real work gathers and fakes dry up.
